candidates.intent: Extract public information tied to a Google account from an email or Google ID (GHunt-style).
candidates.input_contract: an email address or Google account ID
candidates.output_contract: public Google-account details and associated public artifacts
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot query Google's public surfaces to resolve account-linked public data.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic extraction of public Google-account information from an email/ID.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE: investigation/verification but highly privacy-sensitive (people-OSINT) — restrict to consented/authorized cases; EXCLUDE doxxing/stalking. GHunt is AGPL-3.0; wrapper (frishtik) is MIT. Confirm GHunt license/version.

candidates.intent: Run a fast username search across hundreds of sites for quick profile discovery (Blackbird-style).
candidates.output_contract: discovered profiles with site URLs
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot probe hundreds of live sites quickly to find where a handle exists.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds fast 500+-site username reconnaissance returning real profile hits.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE: same brand-protection/investigation vs stalking tension as Sherlock/Maigret — gate to authorized/consented use; EXCLUDE harassment. Blackbird is MIT; wrapper (frishtik) is MIT. Confirm Blackbird license.

candidates.intent: Search public exploit databases (via Shodan) for exploits matching a product/CVE.
candidates.output_contract: matching public exploit references with metadata
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate current public exploit entries for a CVE/product.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic exploit-DB search returning real public exploit references for prioritizing remediation.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE: exploit lookup aids vulnerability remediation AND offensive tooling — gate to authorized/defensive use; do not chain into exploitation. Requires SHODAN_API_KEY; wrapper MIT.

candidates.intent: Search Censys for TLS certificates by domain, fingerprint, or issuer to map an org's PKI footprint.
candidates.output_contract: matching certificates with SANs, issuer, and validity
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot enumerate an organization's real certificates or their SANs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds Censys certificate search returning real certs and SAN-derived subdomains.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE but low-risk: certs are public; benign for PKI inventory and recon. Requires Censys API ID+secret; wrapper MIT.

candidates.intent: Enumerate a domain's subdomains by aggregating search engines and passive sources (Sublist3r-style).
candidates.output_contract: a deduplicated list of discovered subdomains
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot aggregate engines/passive sources to enumerate a domain's real subdomains.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic multi-source subdomain enumeration returning a real subdomain set.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE: asset inventory and recon — gate to authorized scope. Sublist3r is GPL-2.0; OpenOSINT wrapper is MIT. Confirm tool license/version.

candidates.intent: Resolve an IP's geolocation, ASN, hostname, and organization (ipinfo.io-style).
candidates.output_contract: geolocation, ASN, hostname, and org for the IP
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot resolve a live IP's geolocation/ASN/hostname mapping.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds deterministic IP-context resolution returning current geo/ASN/hostname data.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE but low-risk: coarse IP context. Uses ipinfo.io (key/ToS). OpenOSINT is MIT.

candidates.intent: Geolocate an IP and flag whether it is a VPN, proxy, or Tor exit node.
candidates.output_contract: geolocation plus VPN/proxy/Tor classification flags
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot determine whether an IP is anonymizing infrastructure.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds IP2Location lookups returning VPN/proxy/Tor flags for fraud/abuse triage.
candidates.verify_note: DEFENSIVE: fraud/abuse and anomaly triage; low abuse potential. Uses IP2Location.io (key/ToS). OpenOSINT is MIT.

candidates.intent: Detect wildcard DNS for a domain by probing random subdomains to avoid false-positive enumeration.
candidates.output_contract: wildcard present/absent plus the resolving address if any
candidates.gap_hypothesis: A model cannot probe live DNS to tell whether a domain wildcards all subdomains.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a deterministic wildcard-DNS probe that improves subdomain-enumeration accuracy.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE but low-risk: passive DNS probing supports accurate enumeration. No API key needed; wrapper MIT.

candidates.intent: Look up CVE/CPE vulnerability intelligence and which products/hosts are affected.
candidates.input_contract: a CVE id, CPE, or product
candidates.output_contract: vulnerability details and associated CPEs/affected products
candidates.gap_hypothesis: CVE/CPE data is continuously published and a model cannot recall current vulnerability details.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds live CVE/CPE intelligence so an agent reasons over current vulnerability data.
candidates.verify_note: DEFENSIVE: vulnerability triage/prioritization; low abuse potential. License unverified; confirm. Some Shodan endpoints work without a key.

candidates.intent: Expose a bundle of installed OSINT CLIs (Sherlock, Holehe, Maigret, theHarvester, GHunt, Blackbird, SpiderFoot) to an MCP client.
candidates.input_contract: a tool selection plus its target seed (with authorized scope)
candidates.output_contract: the selected tool's structured results over MCP
candidates.gap_hypothesis: An agent cannot install or drive a suite of OSINT CLIs or normalize their varied outputs.
candidates.lift_hypothesis: Adds a single MCP bridge that auto-installs and runs 7 OSINT tools, returning structured results.
candidates.verify_note: DUAL-USE: bundles people-OSINT tools (Sherlock/Holehe/GHunt) — gate to authorized/consented investigations; EXCLUDE doxxing/stalking. Wrapper is MIT; underlying tools carry their own licenses.
